_why: Skill-candidates rows 2495 + 2478. Each row removes one tier or one fail-closed path of local_only_commits.py.

mutations.name: no-ancestor-tier
mutations._mechanism: Without the ancestor check a fast-forwarded branch falls through to `git cherry`, which lists nothing, and reads ON_BASE via=patch instead of MERGED.

mutations.name: no-tree-tier
mutations._mechanism: Row 2478 restored: a squash-merged branch reads UNIQUE, because each commit is `+` to `git cherry`.
mutations.find: if changed and all(tip_tree.get(p) == base_tree.get(p) for p in changed):

mutations.name: tree-tier-compares-nothing
mutations._mechanism: The fail-open the per-path compare exists to avoid: comparing no paths makes every branch ON_BASE.
mutations.find: if changed and all(tip_tree.get(p) == base_tree.get(p) for p in changed):
mutations.replace: if all(tip_tree.get(p) == base_tree.get(p) for p in []):

mutations.name: no-fetch-by-default
mutations._mechanism: The incident restored: a stale local origin/main reads a branch already on the remote main as UNIQUE.

mutations.name: failed-fetch-answers-anyway
mutations._mechanism: A fetch that fails leaves the stale base and still produces a verdict against it.

mutations.name: detached-heads-skipped
mutations._mechanism: Detached linked-worktree HEADs, where h-mad lanes park, drop out of the audit.

mutations.name: unresolved-base-is-a-verdict
mutations._mechanism: A base that does not resolve no longer refuses, so the run fails later or answers against nothing.

mutations.name: partial-reads-unique
mutations._mechanism: A branch half on the base is reported as wholly unique, which hides that some work landed.
